_note_zh: 补采第二轮（2026-11-16）：专攻第一轮 5 个 unknown 中的 4 格 — herdr-M5 / loop-now-M5 / orca-M6 / orca-M12(替换弱证据)。每个 criterion 只放单仓库专属短语，且为正文长句（非路径子串），避免 excerpt 被 README hero 段抢先命中。采集前须过 precheck 碰撞=0。orca SHA 仍为采集时 HEAD，会漂移。

brief.topic: Targeted second-pass sealed collection for four previously-unknown repository/module cells: herdr M5 git-worktree isolation (AGENTS.md methodology), loop-now M5 task workspace clone isolation (concepts.md), orca M6 performance/telemetry observability, orca M12 deployment architecture beyond the README hero paragraph.

criteria.question: herdr: is task work with git worktree isolation documented (dedicated worktree per task, no nested worktrees, edits/tests inside worktree)? — M5
keywords: If the current session is already inside an isolated task worktree
Do all code edits, tests, and validation inside the task worktree
Small changes or small tasks are fine in the default main worktree

criteria.question: loop-now: does each task use a separate cloned workspace (APFS clone copy) that the agent reuses? — M5
keywords: clones the agent folder (APFS clone copy on macOS)
Each participant works in its task context

criteria.question: orca: is there observability/material on performance, telemetry, or status signals (not the README hero paragraph)? — M6
orca: deployment/architecture substrate documented beyond the hero paragraph (cloud VM, SSH remote server, laptop)? — M12
keywords: give a worktree its own cloud VM
Pair a Remote Orca Server, work on any SSH host
Your agents keep running when your laptop sleeps
